---
title: Ziti with Raw Tuna
id: MAR-0118
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 320 g ziti
- 200 g tuna
- 8 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 1 tablespoon fresh oregano
- 1 shallot
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Peel the shallot and chop it finely.
2. Cut the tuna into cubes of 1,5 cm on a side, place them in a bowl, salt them, add the shallot, a grind of pepper, the oregano, the oil and mix.
3. Let marinate in a cool place for one hour.
4. Strain the marinade, keeping the tuna aside.
5. Break the ziti and cook them in boiling salted water; drain them, season with the marinade, distribute on plates, arrange the tuna on top and serve.
